messages:
sam: Heads up  publish pipeline blocked by semver guard. typegen produced a regen-only diff after the publish integration run, bumped SDK 1.7.4 -> 1.8.0. Anyone else seeing monorepo packaging churn?
ci-bot: publish-job-9405 failed: changelog.semver_check failed. Detected version diff 1.7.4 -> 1.8.0. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/9405
ivy: i dug into the artifacts. The freshly-built SDK used in the integration step was packaged with different bundler flags due to a local workspace hoist change: ESM import order changed which altered the generated client header comments and enum casing in one file. typegen diffs that as a change.
noah: interesting. so this is not spec or codegen template change, it's packaging/toolchain noise leaking into generated outputs. that explains why `git blame` looked innocent.
sam: summary of flow: build SDK -> pack -> integration tests (sample-app uses that pack) -> regenerate types -> semver check. Using the just-packaged SDK in the gate lets toolchain differences cascade into typegen.
ivy: short-term mitigation: switch the publish gate integration step to install the last published package from the registry instead of the freshly-packed tarball. That avoids bootstrapping churn. I'll open a pipeline MR.
noah: medium-term fix ideas: (1) add a generation checksum step that compares normalized-generated-output hashes (strip timestamps, header comments, and bundle order) before running semver; (2) pin bundler flags in monorepo CI to be hermetic for publish jobs.
sam: can we also add a semver-guard heuristic: if all diffs are in header/comments, whitespace, or enum-case-only with no spec change, treat as docs-only and surface a normalized marker?
ivy: yes. i'll add a normalizer that strips known noise (build metadata, generated timestamps, header blocks) and a stable sort pass for enums/properties. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/544 (WIP)
ci-bot: preserved artifacts at s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/publish/9405. Excerpt: "Changed enum casing: ACCOUNT_STATUS -> AccountStatus; reordered generated file header with CI build id"
noah: short-term release procedure: introduce label `publish/regen-safety-ok` that a release lead can apply if the diff is confirmed to be build-tooling-only. releases-bot: label `publish/regen-safety-ok` created; applying requires release lead ack and a release note.
sam: please add that label and a one-line instruction in the release guide about when it's permissible. Also add an automated check that the normalized hash equals last-released normalized hash before allowing the label.
ivy: adding the checksum step to pipeline MR and typegen PR will emit `normalized-diff: true` in the changelog metadata when only noise changes. semver guard will treat that as docs-only.
noah: i'll also add an infra MR to pin workspace hoisting and yarn flags for the publish job container. That should prevent accidental bundler flag drift.
sam: great. timeline: pipeline pin MR + typegen normalizer + semver-guard check in the next 48 hours? We need this before Friday's release.
ivy: aiming EOD tomorrow for the pipeline MR and initial normalizer tests. will ask for expedited review.
noah: i'll queue the infra pin MR and add a CI test that runs `yarn pack` both before/after flags and fails if generated output differs after normalization.
releases-bot: reminder: if the release lead applies `publish/regen-safety-ok`, they must post justification in #releases and link the artifacts + PRs.
sam: thanks. if anyone hits this again, ping me and i'll triage the release urgency. :thumbsup:
